name: Project: Ether
detailed_description:
Stop Time. Be a Witch. Save the World.

Project: Ether is a 30-minute vertical slice student project featuring approachable stealth mechanics, diverse story, and unique visuals.

You play as Zhay, agent codename Spirit, who came back from their previous mission with a mysterious soul imbued in their prosthesis only known as The Kid. Explore the mysterious UAD research labs and beyond with the power to enter the Ether dimension with the help of your COVEN witches, Haumea and Bari. Will Spirit find out the mysteries of COVEN and UAD? Can they save the world against the nefarious General Bryant and his unstoppable Guard Bots?

Approachable Stealth

  • Light and Darkness Are Binary.
  • Tap into the Ether dimension to stop time, see through walls, and see more information.
  • Use Hex projectiles to distract enemies or shutdown cameras- manipulate the environment to your will.
  • Accessibility: Features full keyboard and mouse controls rebinding & high-contrast mode.

Diverse story

  • Featuring an all-trans, all-POC cast of characters- fully voice-acted by our all-POC and queer voice cast!
  • Heavy Narrative Focus About Found Family.
  • Solve narrative puzzles in Detective Segments.

Unique Visuals

  • Features anime-inspired, cel-shaded visuals; a departure from other realistic, gritty stealth games.
  • Visual Novel segments in the beginning and end
